findings.summary: `rules += active_promos(now)` mutates the list returned by the now lru_cached `load_rules`, so promos accumulate in the cached tenant rules, causing repeated discounts, never-expiring promos, and promos showing up in list_rules_handler.

judge.reason: Identifies in-place extend of the cached list accumulating promos, same as b1.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Per-process cache with no expiry means other workers/hosts keep serving stale rules after save_rules until restart, since cache_clear only runs in the saving process.

judge.reason: Describes the known stale-cache across processes problem, not b1.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: Cache is cleared after put_rules without a lock, so a concurrent load_rules can cache stale rules just after the clear; the clear also drops all tenants' entries (performance cost only).

judge.reason: Race between put_rules and cache_clear is a plausible real defect in the changed code, though not in the key.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: Test ends with a second save_rules call and no assertion, no test calls price_quote twice (so the cache mutation bug passes), and the test leaves shared in-memory DB with globex's rule set to 12.

judge.reason: Notes tests fail to cover the cache mutation bug, which is always valid_other.
